game: TEN @ NYG, Week 3 2026 (kickoff time, rest, travel, open line not in pack)

script.base: Spread and total were not saved, so the script is the matchup, not an implied total. NYG has allowed 5.47 YPC and 7 runs of 10+ while TEN has allowed 3.59 YPC and only 3 runs of 10+. Base flow is competitive or slightly TEN-leaning on the ground: Tony Pollard (21 carries, 99 yards) gets the early TEN carries, Cam Skattebo (30 carries, 117 yards, 3.9 YPC) stays the NYG bellcow but is efficiency-capped, and NYG has to throw to Isaiah Likely (18 targets, 111 yards) because Cam Ward's EPA/db is negative both vs blitz (-0.07) and vs no blitz (-0.05). Not a shootout lean.
script.flip1: NYG leads and clocks out. Skattebo's carries jump toward 18+ and the rush under dies; Pollard's second-half carries stall; Likely's target volume falls with the pass rate.
script.flip2: TEN blitzes (24%) and NYG's -0.63 EPA/db vs blitz shows up as sacks and three-and-outs. Deep air to Malik Nabers (180) and Malachi Fields (202) dies, checkdowns and Likely become the offense, and a TEN lead cuts Skattebo's rush attempts further.

injury_fallout: No player is OUT or Doubtful. Questionable only, source the pre-game nflverse injury report: NYG LB Brian Burns (ankle) — if inactive, less edge pressure on Ward, which helps TEN rush efficiency and deep shots (Calvin Ridley is not in the two-week target table; Carnell Tate has 117 air yards, Elic Ayomanor 74). NYG CB Deonte Banks (calf) and S Tyler Nubin (calf) — if both sit, Tate/Ayomanor/any Ridley routes face backups; not confirmed, so not sized. TEN CB Cordale Flott (quad) — if out, Nabers/Darnell Mooney/Fields get a softer outside look; not confirmed. TEN RB Tyjae Spears (ankle) — 10 carries and 6 targets in two weeks; if limited or inactive, Pollard (21 carries, 3 targets) is next man up. Spears is only Questionable, so his overs are not bet and Pollard's lines are a sleeper watch, not a confirmed bump.

matchup.pressure: NYG blitzes 25%; TEN EPA/db is -0.07 vs blitz and -0.05 vs none, so pressure is not a Ward checkdown edge. TEN blitzes 24%; NYG EPA/db is -0.63 vs blitz and +0.48 vs none. Pressure that gets home kills NYG deep yards (Nabers 180 air, Fields 202 air) and points the remaining completions toward the TE/RB.
matchup.bleeds: NYG bleeds the run: 5.47 YPC, 7 runs of 10+, and only 5 passes of 20+. Their pass YPA is still high — middle 12.0 on 5 attempts, left 7.5 on 32, right 7.48 on 27. TEN bleeds explosives and the right side, not the run: 3.59 YPC and 3 runs of 10+, but 8 passes of 20+ and YPA right 8.34 (29), left 7.68 (19), middle 7.0 (13).
matchup.overlap: Cleanest overlap is TEN's run game into NYG's 5.47 YPC, but Pollard is only at 10.5 carries and 49.5 rush yards per game, so 10.5 times 5.47 is about 57, short of 59.5 unless Spears sits. NYG's usable overlap is Likely, the 18-target leader, into a TEN pass defense allowing explosives, with the blitz profile hurting Nabers and Fields more than the TE.

Skattebo rush 81 and 36 (mean 58.5) vs 59.5 — the 81 is a spike, not a trend. Likely receiving 78 and 33 vs 38.5 on 18 targets / 111 yards (mean 55.5); cleared once, missed by 5.5 once. Fields 25 and 30, both over 22.5, but only 55 yards on 202 air yards. Nabers 69 and 1 vs a 54 line, 70 yards on 180 air and 13 targets. Tate 38 and 27, both under 39, 65 yards on 117 air. Ayomanor 11 and 69 vs 13.5, spike-dependent on 6 targets. Mooney 27 and 48 on only 5 targets. Spears 12 and 41 rush, 12 and 29 receiving, and he is questionable. Ridley has a single listed 35 and is absent from the target table. Tyrone Tracy Jr. has one listed rush game of 14 and is not in the NYG rusher group (Skattebo, Singletary 9/25, Dart 8/59, Harris 4/6). Jameis Winston's listed rush mark is 1, so Dart, not Winston, has the scramble sample.

edge_players.edge_sentence: Isaiah Likely is New York's target leader at 18 targets and 111 yards through two games (55.5 per game) against a 38.5 line, and Tennessee has allowed 8 passes of 20+ with 7.0–8.34 YPA, so the volume TE is aimed at the pass bleed while the blitz profile hurts the deep receivers more than him.
edge_players.must_be_true: He keeps a full route share near 8–9 targets, Tennessee does not take the TE away all afternoon, and the game does not become a pure Skattebo clock-grind with NYG barely throwing.
edge_players.kills_it: Tennessee's 24% blitz turns NYG's -0.63 EPA/db vs blitz into three-and-outs, or the 78-yard game was one explosive and the 33-yard game is the real baseline under 38.5.

data_check.notes: No sims and no separate Pinnacle number in the pack; consensus no-vig is about 0.50 on both legs, so neither beats the anchor on price. Hand means only, not 3-sim probabilities, and neither model_p is near 70%. Likely's 55.5 mean vs 38.5 agrees with the strong over, but the 33-yard miss and NYG's -0.63 EPA/db against a 24% TEN blitz disagree with sizing it — flag, do not cut. Skattebo's matchup math (about 54) mildly agrees with the under; his raw 58.5 mean and the 81-yard game do not show separation, so the lean stays matchup-only. Pollard rush over 59.5 was the other real matchup read (NYG 5.47 YPC, 7 runs of 10+) but 10.5 carries project about 57 and his games are 35 and 64, so that lean was dropped instead of forced. Spears being Questionable blocked any Spears leg.

pre_mortem: Monday this lost if Tennessee's blitz turned New York's -0.63 EPA per dropback vs blitz into a three-and-out afternoon and Likely's 78 was one explosive, leaving the 33-yard game that already missed 38.5; there are also no snap or route counts to prove the 18 targets are structural rather than script noise. Skattebo's under lost if the unsaved spread had NYG ahead and he got 18-plus carries, or if he broke another chunk run the way he did for 81, against a TEN run sample that is only two games at 3.59 YPC. A late inactive among Spears, Burns, Banks, Nubin or Flott — all Questionable, none confirmed — would change backfield share and coverage after this read, and unsaved MetLife weather could drag the Likely over into a slog.
slip_story: One story only: Tennessee's front (3.59 YPC allowed, 3 runs of 10+) caps Skattebo's rush yards, and New York, unable to run efficiently and fragile if blitzed, funnels throws to target leader Isaiah Likely. The two win together in a competitive or NYG-trailing game. They split if NYG leads and clocks (Skattebo over, Likely under) or if the game is a defensive slog (Skattebo under can still hit, Likely over dies). Do not add Pollard, Nabers, Fields, or any touchdown. Two-leg card; no bet placed.
